title: Solar System Quick Quiz
subtitle: A tiny example of the quizwimg config format

questions.prompt: How many planets are in the Solar System?
questions.explanation: Eight, since Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.

questions.vignette: One planet contains more mass than all the other planets combined.
questions.explanation: Jupiter — about 2.5 times the mass of all other planets combined.

questions.prompt: Which planet has the hottest surface?
questions.explanation: Venus (~465°C): its dense CO2 atmosphere traps heat, beating Mercury despite being farther from the Sun.

questions.prompt: How many moons does Mars have?
questions.explanation: Two small moons: Phobos and Deimos.
